column.headline: Haaland's blank hands the summit to Ayodele
column.text: Ayodele takes the top spot on 700 after a 61-point week, 8 clear of Cherag, who slipped to 2nd when Rayan returned only 4 as captain. The real story is the Haaland bloc: 21 managers captained him and every one of them got just 4 points for the armband. Hishaan's Barry gamble is still paying off, with 32 captain points lifting him from 14th to 9th, and nobody else owns him. Dominic's 75 was the week's best score, and Saurabh's Isak captain kept his Tin Pot climb going.

plots.title: Nihal's Climb Holds
plots.text: Nihal has climbed from 26th of 29 in GW1 to 4th, and has held that spot for 2 weeks. The climb has been steady, with places gained in almost every week since GW3.
plots.next: If the climb continues, Nihal could be a serious challenger for the top 3.
plots.question: How high can Nihal go?

plots.title: Ayodele Seizes the Crown
plots.text: Ayodele overturned Cherag's lead, moving 8 points clear at 700 to 692 after Cherag had led for 6 weeks. This is Ayodele's first week on top this season, and the lead has changed hands 4 times.
plots.next: Cherag could hit back quickly, and Sid sits 29 points off the lead.
plots.question: Who can hold the crown?

plots.title: Hishaan Draws Level
plots.text: Hishaan has cut a 47-point deficit to Bhavik down to nothing, and the 2 are now level. The gap has shrunk every week since GW7.
plots.next: Whoever scores next could take the lead, and the chase is now in the open.
plots.question: Can Hishaan catch Bhavik?

plots.title: Edd Keeps Rolling
plots.text: Edd has been above the league average for 6 weeks in a row, with a 67-point return in GW10. The only dip came in GW8, when Edd scored 49.
plots.next: If Edd keeps this up, a 7th straight week above average is on the cards.
plots.question: How long can Edd stay hot?

plots.title: Tobi's Bounce Back
plots.text: Tobi is still below the league average, but 58 points in GW10 is a sharp rebound from 37 the week before. The run now stands at 6 weeks below average.
plots.next: A second strong week could be the start of a turnaround for Tobi.
plots.question: Can Tobi snap out of it?

title.title: The Crown Slips Away
title.text: Cherag holds the top spot on 665, but Ayodele is close behind on 657, just 8 points back. The lead has changed hands 3 times this season, and Sid sits 32 points adrift in third.

title.title: Ayodele Seizes the Crown
title.text: Ayodele overturned Cherag's lead, moving 8 points clear at 700 to 692 after Cherag had led for 6 weeks. This is Ayodele's first week on top this season, and the lead has changed hands 4 times.
title.next: Cherag could hit back quickly, and Sid sits 29 points off the lead.

gamble:3506595:10.title: Hishaan's Bold Armband
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan backed Barry as captain, a choice only one manager made, and it returned 32 points. The gamble lifted Hishaan from 14th to 8th while most managers followed Haaland, who was captained by 21.

gamble:3506595:10.title: The Armband Pays Off
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan's lone Barry armband paid off with 32 points, a gamble only one manager took. The move has carried Hishaan up to 9th from 14th, while 21 managers followed Haaland.

chase:4922092.title: Ravi Closes In
chase:4922092.text: Ravi has chased Bhavik down from 32 points behind in GW7 to 14 in GW8 and then just 1 in GW9. Live in GW10, the pair are now level.

gold.title: Fight for the Gold
gold.text: Only 4 spots sit in the Gold zone, and Nihal currently holds the last one. Nanik is first out, 5 points behind, and both have spent 2 of the last 5 weeks inside the zone.

rivalry:3506595-7471754.title: Hishaan vs Tonna
rivalry:3506595-7471754.text: Hishaan and Tonna have swapped places 6 times this season, and Tonna once led by 31 points in GW8. Live in GW10, Hishaan has pulled back ahead by 8.

underdog:573491.title: Nihal's Climb Holds
underdog:573491.text: Nihal has climbed from 26th of 29 in GW1 to 4th, and has held that spot for 2 weeks. The climb has been steady, with places gained in almost every week since GW3.
underdog:573491.next: If the climb continues, Nihal could be a serious challenger for the top 3.

chase:3506595.title: Hishaan Draws Level
chase:3506595.text: Hishaan has cut a 47-point deficit to Bhavik down to nothing, and the 2 are now level. The gap has shrunk every week since GW7.
chase:3506595.next: Whoever scores next could take the lead, and the chase is now in the open.

hot:1378937.title: Edd Keeps Rolling
hot:1378937.text: Edd has been above the league average for 6 weeks in a row, with a 67-point return in GW10. The only dip came in GW8, when Edd scored 49.
hot:1378937.next: If Edd keeps this up, a 7th straight week above average is on the cards.

slump:383423.title: Tobi's Bounce Back
slump:383423.text: Tobi is still below the league average, but 58 points in GW10 is a sharp rebound from 37 the week before. The run now stands at 6 weeks below average.
slump:383423.next: A second strong week could be the start of a turnaround for Tobi.

fall:5873092.title: Justin's Slide Continues
fall:5873092.text: Justin has dropped from 7th in GW6 to 17th, having bottomed out at 18th in GW9. A single place back in GW10 is the first hint of a turn.
fall:5873092.next: Could Justin claw back towards the top 10, or slide further?
